## Activity

During May 2022, Central Eye Clinic completed 170 photographic captures. This provides the activity level for the reporting period and supports review of the clinic’s imaging and grading performance.

The recorded activity should continue to be monitored alongside image quality and grading outcomes. Any operational issues affecting the capture process should be recorded promptly to support follow-up and service improvement.

## Image quality

Of the 170 captures, 4 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.4 per cent. This result should be reviewed as part of routine quality monitoring, with recurring camera issues logged with the service desk for investigation and resolution.

## Grading

A total of 38 results were graded referable during May 2022. The median grading lag was 23 days. This measure should be considered alongside the volume of referable results and the overall activity recorded for the clinic.

The clinic should continue to monitor grading times and image quality through routine operational review. Where issues recur, records should include sufficient detail to help the service desk identify trends and coordinate corrective action.
